status_note: PROPOSED tolerances, not an approved scientific release policy. check_regression.py treats the evaluation as advisory until 'approved' is true and 'approval' names who approved it, when, and the issue or PR that records the decision. Until then the scientific release decision remains the maintainer review described in the prep-release skill.
rule: A metric fails when its increase (candidate - previous; |MBE| for bias) exceeds max(floor, relative * previous). Only full-period statistics are evaluated; seasonal and window breakdowns stay descriptive (bench_drift.py). Every quantity the previous release carries must be present and finite in the candidate.
provenance: Proposed on 2026-09-07 from the recorded release history under results/ (2025.7.6 .. 2026.6.5): energy-balance MAE moved by at most 0.03 W m^-2 between consecutive releases; the RSL 6.5 m air-temperature MAE moved by +0.12 K at 2026.1.28 -> 2026.4.3. The 0.05 floors reuse the display band on the benchmark page. None of this is a scientific justification of the values; it only makes the recorded history consistent with the proposal.
rationale: The historical sweep in CI is a consistency diagnostic: it fails if the recorded history or these numbers change without the other being updated. It is not evidence that the tolerances detect every scientifically meaningful regression, and a candidate within them has not been shown to be free of regression.

exceptions.review: No scientific review decision on record; this entry only records the shift so the historical sweep stays consistent. It waives nothing else on this pair.
exceptions.evidence: https://github.com/UMEP-dev/SUEWS/pull/1116 (merged 2026-03-10, within this release cycle) changed the RSL profile physics; the shift is shown on the benchmark page.
exceptions.reason: 6.5 m air-temperature MAE 0.42 -> 0.54 K (+0.12 K) coincides with the RSL profile change in PR #1116.
